mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_runs (id, user_id, chapter_id, language, source_code, stdin_text, status, output_text, error_text, duration_ms) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{chapterId}, #{language}, #{sourceCode}, #{stdinText}, #{status}, #{outputText}, #{errorText}, #{durationMs})
